lines.japanese: 「よ、杉浦！」
lines.english: “Hey, Sugiura!”

lines.japanese: 「…おはよう、小木曽」
lines.english: “…Morning, Ogiso.”

lines.japanese:
「週末どうだった？　あ、バイトだっけ？
俺はまぁ、ケーキ食って肉食って酒止められて
仕方ないからシラフで騒いだくらいだったけど…」
lines.english: “How was your weekend? Oh, right—you were working. Me, I ate cake, ate meat, got banned from drinking, and had to make do with raising hell sober…”

lines.japanese:
「入試を一週間後に控えて
それだけできれば大したものだと思う。
本当に度胸据わってるね、小木曽は」
lines.english: “With entrance exams only a week away, managing that much is impressive. Nothing scares you, does it, Ogiso?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「今日は、先週よりちょっとだけ元気そうかなって」
lines.english: “You seem a little more alive than you did last week.”

lines.japanese:
「…バイト、忙しかったからね。
息つく暇もないくらい」
lines.english: “…Work was busy. I barely had time to breathe.”

lines.japanese:
「忙しいと元気になるのかよ。
本当に貧乏性だな、杉浦は」
lines.english: “Being busy cheers you up? You really don’t know what to do with yourself, Sugiura.”
“…You could say that.”

lines.japanese:
「でもよかった。もうすぐ卒業だもんな。
残り二週間、その調子で楽しく…」
lines.english: “Still, I’m glad. Graduation’s almost here. Keep it up and enjoy these last two weeks…”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ごめん、そろそろ行かないと」
lines.english: “Oh, sorry. I have to go.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、今から体育だっけ？」
lines.english: “You’ve got gym now, right?”

lines.japanese: 「そう…更衣室」
lines.english: “Yes… the changing room.”

lines.japanese: 「悪かったな、着替えの時間ギリギリになっちまった」
lines.english: “Sorry I kept you talking until you barely have time to change.”

lines.japanese: 「………着替え、か」
lines.english: “………Changing, hm.”
“Sugiura?”

lines.japanese: 「ふふ…楽しくなりそうだなぁ」
lines.english: “Heh… This might be fun.”

lines.japanese: 「どうしたんだよ突然？」
lines.english: “What’s gotten into you?”

lines.japanese:
「知ってる小木曽？
わたし、スポーツ大好きなんだ」
lines.english: “Did you know, Ogiso? I love sports.”

lines.japanese:
「そりゃ…知ってるけどさ。
大会も見に行ったし」
lines.english: “Of course I know. I even went to see you compete.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、ね…ふふ」
lines.english: “See you later… heh.”

lines.japanese:
「みんながそう思ってるなら…なってあげるよ。
みんなが望むビッチに、ね」
lines.english: “If that’s what everyone thinks I am… then I’ll become it for them. The slut they all want.”

lines.japanese: 『ごちそうさま』
lines.english: “Thanks for the meal.”

lines.japanese:
『料理、受け取った。
届けてくれてありがとう。
それと、連絡取れずに本当にごめん』
lines.english: “I got the food. Thank you for bringing it. And I’m truly sorry I was out of touch.”

lines.japanese:
『土曜からバイト先がパニクってて、
深夜まで働きづめで、部屋に帰っても寝るだけ。
メールがチェックできてなかった』
lines.english: “Things at work have been in chaos since Saturday. I was working nonstop until late each night and doing nothing but sleeping once I got home, so I hadn’t checked my messages.”

lines.japanese:
『そういうわけで、荷物を受け取った後で、
やっと雪菜のメールに気づいたくらいだった。
心配と、嫌な思いさせてしまってごめん』
lines.english: “In fact, I didn’t see your message until after I received the package. I’m sorry I worried you and made you feel so awful.”

lines.japanese:
何度もついてるくせに、
いつまで経っても嘘が上手くならないな、俺…
lines.english: I lied often enough, but I never seemed to get any better at it…

lines.japanese:
これが出版社の方なら説得力もあるけど、
深夜営業もないファミレスでそんな不測の事態が
起こるのかと聞かれれば、返す言葉もない。
lines.english: The story might have sounded plausible if I still worked at the publisher. Ask what kind of emergency could keep anyone past midnight at a family restaurant that did not even stay open late, and I would have no answer.

lines.japanese: …そんな事情も知らない雪菜だからこそつける嘘。
lines.english: It was a lie I could tell only because Setsuna did not know that.

lines.japanese:
こんなふうに人を見て言葉を作ってしまうのは、
昔の俺が、ずっと嫌悪してやまない態度だった…
lines.english: Tailoring my words to another person’s ignorance was exactly the sort of behavior my old self had always despised.

lines.japanese:
『料理、今さっき食べた。
雪菜の言う通り、焼き加減も味付けも最高だった。
冷めてても本当に美味しかった』
lines.english: “I just ate the food. You were right—the seasoning and the way you cooked it were perfect. It was delicious even cold.”

lines.japanese:
『ケーキもありがとう。
それと、毎年ありがとう』
lines.english: “Thank you for the cake too. And thank you for doing this every year.”

lines.japanese:
『最後に、当日になったからもう一度。
誕生日、おめでとう』
lines.english: “And now that the day itself is here, let me say it once more. Happy birthday.”

lines.japanese:
だから最後だけは真実の言葉で、
少しでも良心の呵責を抑え込む。
lines.english: Only at the end did I tell the truth, trying to quiet my conscience at least a little.

lines.japanese:
このメールを見て、
きっと雪菜は納得してしまうだろう。
疑問があっても、無理やり抑え込んでしまうだろう。
lines.english: Setsuna would surely accept this message. Even if doubts remained, she would force them down.

lines.japanese:
結局、そのことだけは、
どれだけ取り繕っても、
俺の頭から消えることはないんだけどな。
lines.english: And no matter how carefully I dressed things up, that knowledge would never leave me.

lines.japanese: それにしても…
lines.english: Still…

lines.japanese: やっぱり受信簿に、一昨日の雪菜からのメールはない。
lines.english: Setsuna’s message from two days ago was definitely not in my inbox.

lines.japanese: メール不達か、メールが消えたか…
lines.english: Either it had never arrived, or it had disappeared.

lines.japanese:
もし、不達でないとしたら、
どこで消えたのか…
lines.english: And if it had arrived, where had it disappeared…?

lines.japanese: そんな可能性、一つしかない。
lines.english: There was only one possibility.

lines.japanese:
土曜の夜は、俺の方が先に眠ってしまってた。
…そして小春は起きていた。
lines.english: On Saturday night, I had fallen asleep first… while Koharu remained awake.

lines.japanese:
携帯は、部屋に転がってた。
ロックなんかかけてないから、誰でも操作できた。
lines.english: My phone had been lying in the room. It had no lock; anyone could have used it.

lines.japanese: 「小春…」
lines.english: “Koharu…”

lines.japanese:
もし俺の推測が当たってるとしたら…
お前は、どこへ行こうとしてるんだ？
lines.english: If my suspicion was right… where were you headed, Koharu?

lines.japanese:
お前がこうなってしまったのは俺のせいだけど、
俺が悪いって結論に、誰の反論も
受け入れるつもりはないけど。
lines.english: I was the reason you had become this way. I would accept no argument against the conclusion that it was my fault.

lines.japanese:
でも、嘘の比率が上がりすぎだろ。
俺にも、本心を語らなさすぎだろ。
lines.english: But too much of your life had become lies. You hid far too much of your heart even from me.

lines.japanese:
お前の真実は、
お前の誠実は…
lines.english: Your truth… your integrity…

lines.japanese: 一体、どこに行ってしまったんだよ？
lines.english: Where had they gone?

lines.japanese:
「あれ？　来てたんだ孝宏。
なんで体育サボったん？」
lines.english: “Oh, you came, Takahiro. Why’d you skip gym?”

lines.japanese:
「そんなことやってる時間ないからだよ。
本番まであと５日だぜ？」
lines.english: “Because I don’t have time for that. The exam’s five days away.”

lines.japanese:
「だったらわざわざ学校なんかに来なくても…
どうせもう自主登校なんだから」
lines.english: “Then why come to school at all? Attendance is optional now.”

lines.japanese:
「一応、委員長だしな。
それにちょっと気になることがあったし」
lines.english: “I am still class president. And there was something I wanted to check.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと気になること、ねぇ…」
lines.english: “Something you wanted to check, huh…”

lines.japanese:
「それよりも悪いけど馬鹿話なら遠慮してくれ。
週末もパーティとかであんま進んでなくて、
正直ヤバいと思うようになってきた」
lines.english: “Anyway, spare me the idle chatter. I barely studied over the weekend with the party and everything, and I’m honestly starting to panic.”

lines.japanese:
「お前ほどの脳天気がそう思うってことは、
実質的には絶望レベルか…」
lines.english: “If someone as carefree as you is panicking, the situation must be beyond hope.”

lines.japanese: 「うっせ」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese:
「じゃあ、馬鹿話というには楽しくはないけど、
洒落にならないという意味ではとびっきりの新ネタを」
lines.english: “All right, then. It’s not exactly fun gossip—but if you want something that’s no laughing matter, I’ve got a hell of a story.”

lines.japanese: 「人がヤバいって言ってんのに釣るなよ…」
lines.english: “Don’t bait me after I just said I’m in trouble…”

lines.japanese:
「さっきの体育の時間…
女子どもが、また大炎上してたぞ」
lines.english: “During PE just now… things blew up all over again among the girls.”

lines.japanese: 「…何だそりゃ？」
lines.english: “…What does that mean?”

lines.japanese: 「多分、もうすぐわかる」
lines.english: “You’ll find out soon enough.”

lines.japanese:
「なにあいつ！？
これ見よがしに！」
lines.english: “What is wrong with her? Flaunting it like that!”

lines.japanese:
「何がしたいんだろうね、あれ？
さっぱりわからない」
lines.english: “What’s she even trying to accomplish? I don’t understand.”

lines.japanese: 「あてつけ？」
lines.english: “Is it some kind of dig?”

lines.japanese: 「って、誰に対してよ？」
lines.english: “At whom?”

lines.japanese:
「自分で『私は淫乱です』って、
背中に貼ってるみたいなもんじゃんねぇ」
lines.english: “She might as well paste a sign on her back saying, ‘I’m a slut.’”

lines.japanese:
「あ～んな恥も外聞もない奴とは思わなかった。
どんな顔してクラス委員なんかやってたんだか」
lines.english: “I never imagined she could be so shameless. How did she ever dare act like our class president?”

lines.japanese: 「もうやりたい放題だね…」
lines.english: “She does whatever she wants now…”

lines.japanese: 「あれで答辞読むの？　本当に？」
lines.english: “And she’s really giving the valedictory address?”

lines.japanese:
「もう三年の恥。それどころか付属の恥。大恥！
消えて欲しいわマジで！」
lines.english: “She’s a disgrace to our year—to Houjou High. An absolute disgrace! I seriously wish she’d disappear!”

lines.japanese: 「………どういうこと、だよ？」
lines.english: “………What are they talking about?”

lines.japanese:
「それがさ…
更衣室で服脱いだら、
全身キスマークだらけだったんだと」
lines.english: “Apparently, when she took off her clothes in the changing room, she had hickeys all over her body.”
“………What?”

lines.japanese:
「背中とか、肩とか、首とかさ。
しかも歯形まで」
lines.english: “All over her back, shoulders, neck. There were even teeth marks.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ちょっと待て…」
lines.english: “Wait a minute…”

lines.japanese:
「しかもそれを隠しもせずに、
堂々と背中見せつけるようにして着替えてたってさ。
…更衣室にいた女子全員凍りついてたってよ」
lines.english: “And she didn’t try to hide them. She changed like she was deliberately showing everyone her back. Every girl in the room supposedly froze solid.”

lines.japanese: 「………杉浦のこと、だよな？」
lines.english: “………They mean Sugiura, don’t they?”

lines.japanese:
「例の噂にキレちまったのか、
元からそういう性格だったのか…
ま、火に油を注いでることは間違いないけどな」
lines.english: “Maybe the rumors finally made her snap, or maybe she was always like this. Either way, she’s certainly pouring oil on the fire.”

lines.japanese:
「で、杉浦は？
あいつは今、どこにいるんだよ？」
lines.english: “Where’s Sugiura? Where is she now?”

lines.japanese: 「帰ったよ、さっき…」
lines.english: “She went home a little while ago.”

lines.japanese: 「…まだ一時間目が終わったところだぞ？」
lines.english: “…First period only just ended.”

lines.japanese:
「自主登校だからな。
別に誰も咎める奴はいないよ」
lines.english: “Attendance is optional. No one’s going to stop her.”

lines.japanese: 「それは…」
lines.english: “But…”

lines.japanese:
「でも、だったらどうして
体育の時間だけ来たんだろうな？
…なんて、見せつけるため以外の何物でもないか」
lines.english: “Why come only for PE, then? …Though I guess there’s no explanation except that she wanted everyone to see.”

lines.japanese:
「けど、どうやら男取ったってのは本当らしいな。
火のないところに煙はって言うけど、
ま～それにしても」
lines.english: “Looks like the part about her taking someone’s man was true. They say where there’s smoke… but even so—”

lines.japanese: 「どこへ行こうとしてんだよ…杉浦」
lines.english: “Where are you trying to go, Sugiura?”
